description: This file is a shell script (.sh) that automates end-to-end testing (smoke tests) for a software deployment on a macOS Parallels VM. It defines functions and logic for VM snapshot management, installation, verification, and interactions with external services like Discord. It orchestrates a sequence of steps to restore snapshots, install packages, onboard, verify status, run smoke tests, and generate a JSON summary of the results.

methods.name: resolve_snapshot_info
methods.description: Calculates and selects the best snapshot based on a fuzzy match of snapshot name hints.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Detects or overrides the host IP address used for server installation.

methods.name: verify_version_contains
methods.description: Verifies that the installed openclaw version contains a specified substring.

methods.name: extract_package_version_from_tgz
methods.description: Extracts the version string from the package.json inside a tar.gz archive.

methods.name: extract_package_build_commit_from_tgz
methods.description: Extracts the build commit identifier from a build-info.json inside a tar.gz archive.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Creates a tar.gz package of the current build, either from a target npm spec or current local build, and records its version info.

methods.name: verify_target_version
methods.description: Checks that the currently packaged or specified target version matches expectations.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts a local HTTP server to serve the main package tarball for installation.

methods.name: verify_bundle_permissions
methods.description: Verifies permissions of global npm package directories to prevent insecure installations.

methods.name: run_ref_onboard
methods.description: Runs an onboarding process in reference mode within the guest VM.

methods.name: verify_gateway
methods.description: Checks the status of the openclaw gateway service.

methods.name: verify_dashboard_load
methods.description: Verifies that the openclaw dashboard loads correctly in a web browser.

methods.name: configure_discord_smoke
methods.description: Configures Discord bot and channels for smoke testing.

methods.name: run_discord_roundtrip_smoke
methods.description: Performs a roundtrip message exchange with Discord as part of the smoke test.

methods.name: show_log_excerpt
methods.description: Displays the tail of log files for diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: write_summary_json
methods.description: Writes a JSON report summarizing the test outcomes.

methods.name: capture_latest_ref_failure
methods.description: Runs onboard in latest-ref mode and detects failure for diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: run_fresh_main_lane
methods.description: Executes the sequence for a 'fresh' snapshot, including restoring, installing, onboarding, and verification steps.

methods.name: run_upgrade_lane
methods.description: Executes the sequence for an 'upgrade' scenario, including restoring, installing the latest release, onboarding, and verification steps.
